test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Consider the below statements and identify the correct answer.

**Statement I:** During indigestion, the stomach produces too much acid, and this causes pain and irritation.

**Statement-II:** To get rid of this pain, people use bases called antacids like magnesium hydroxide

options.text: Statement-I is true, and statement-II is false.
Statement-II is true, and statement-I is false.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both the statements are true**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• During indigestion, the stomach produces too much acid, particularly **hydrochloric acid (HCl)**, which can cause pain and irritation in the stomach lining.
 
• This condition is commonly known as **acidity or acid reflux**.
 
• To relieve this pain, people use **antacids**, which are basic substances that help to neutralize the excess stomach acid.
 
• One common example of an antacid is **magnesium hydroxide** (also known as milk of magnesia).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The human digestive system consists of several organs, including the** mouth, esophagus, stomach, small intestine, large intestine, and accessory organs such as the liver, pancreas, and gallbladder.**
 
• Digestion primarily involves the breakdown of food by enzymes. Different enzymes target specific types of nutrients:
 
 
• **Amylase** breaks down carbohydrates (found in saliva).
 
• **Protease** breaks down proteins.
 
• **Lipase** breaks down fats.
 
 
 
• The **stomach** secretes gastric juices, including **hydrochloric acid and pepsin**, to break down food into a semi-liquid form called **chyme**
 
• The **small intestine** is where most digestion and absorption occur. It is approximately** 20 feet long.**
 
• The liver produces **bile**, which is **stored in the gallbladder**. Bile is essential for the digestion and absorption of fats.
 
• The** large intestine** (colon) absorbs water, electrolytes, and vitamins produced by gut bacteria.
